description: Authoritative performance byte budgets for the frontend bundle. This is the SINGLE source of truth; rsbuild.config.ts, the Lighthouse configs, scripts/bundle-size-report.mjs, the make perf-budget target, and the docs tables all read from here. Never scatter these numbers elsewhere. Satisfy a budget by reducing/splitting the bundle, never by raising a limit without rationale (see issue #117).

rationale.raw.maxInitialEntrypointBytes: Uncompressed size of the initial (eager) entrypoint, enforced by Rspack performance hints (hints: 'error') so a build that grows the eager bundle past this fails CI. Measured baseline ~388 KB; budget adds ~21% headroom for incremental growth while catching a doubling.
rationale.raw.maxAssetBytes: Uncompressed size ceiling for any single emitted JS/CSS asset (async route chunks included), enforced by Rspack performance hints. Measured largest chunk ~318 KB (the deferred auth/DI graph); budget adds ~26% headroom while catching a single page ballooning.
rationale.gzip.maxInitialEntrypointBytes: Transfer-size (gzip) ceiling for the eager entrypoint total, enforced by scripts/bundle-size-report.mjs (fails the bundle-size workflow when breached). Measured baseline ~128 KB; budget adds ~29% headroom.
rationale.gzip.maxAssetBytes: Transfer-size (gzip) ceiling for any single named/async JS chunk, enforced by scripts/bundle-size-report.mjs. Measured largest ~101 KB; budget adds ~29% headroom.
rationale.lighthouse.scriptSizeBytes: Lighthouse resource-summary:script:size (error). The production image serves with serve@14, which does NOT gzip, so Lighthouse transfer size equals uncompressed bytes. Calibrated against the heaviest page's eager+route script total (~0.5 MB raw) to fail deterministically on a large regression without flaking on measurement variance; the tight, fully-measured gates are the Rspack raw hints and the gzip bundle-size report.
rationale.lighthouse.totalSizeBytes: Lighthouse resource-summary:total:size (error) — ceiling for total transferred bytes (scripts + document + fonts + images), uncompressed as above.
rationale.lighthouse.scriptCountWarn: Lighthouse resource-summary:script:count (warn) — flags request-count growth without failing CI, since request count varies with route-level splitting.

measuredBaseline.server: serve@14 (no gzip; Lighthouse transfer size == uncompressed)
